rsvpAdmin.title: RSVPs
rsvpAdmin.description: Who’s coming, who hasn’t replied yet, and what everyone is eating.
rsvpAdmin.copyFailed: Couldn’t copy automatically. Please copy it by hand.
rsvpAdmin.nothingText: Add guests and invite them to your events on the Guests page. Each household then gets its own private RSVP link.
rsvpAdmin.shareText: Hi {name}! Please RSVP for {couple}’s wedding here: {link}
rsvpAdmin.whatsappText: Hi {name}! Please RSVP for {couple}’s wedding here: {link}

setup.title: RSVP settings
setup.description: What guests see on their RSVP page.
setup.deadlineHint: After this date guests can’t change their answers online.
setup.askTravelHint: After RSVPing yes, guests can share arrival and departure details, where they're staying and if they need a transfer.
setup.findSeatHint: Guests can type their name on a public page to see their table assignment.
setup.notifyOn: Sent to owners and editors, in addition to the bell in the app.
setup.notifyOff: Needs Resend and the Supabase secret key (see README). You’ll still get in-app notifications.
setup.mealsText: Guests choose one when they accept an event that asks for meals.
setup.noMeals: No meal options yet, so guests won’t be asked. Add e.g. “Beef”, “Fish”, “Vegetarian”, “Children’s menu”.
setup.deleteText: Guests who picked it will keep their RSVP but lose the meal choice.
setup.mealEvents: Which events ask for a meal?
setup.noEvents: No events yet. Add them in Settings.
setup.askAt: Ask for a meal choice at {name}

email.title: Email your guests
email.description: Each household gets one email with its private RSVP link, sent to everyone in it who has an email address. It’s written in the household’s language.
email.notSetUp: Email isn’t set up yet. Add a free Resend API key as RESEND_API_KEY in .env.local (see the README), then restart the app. Meanwhile you can copy each household’s link or share it on WhatsApp from the RSVP page.
email.willGet: {count} {count, plural, one {household will get an email.} other {households will get an email.}}
email.skipped: {count} without an email address will be skipped: {names}. Share their link on WhatsApp instead.
email.notePlaceholder: e.g. We can’t wait to celebrate with you in Sintra!
email.sent: {sent, plural, one {Sent to # household} other {Sent to # households}}
email.sentFailed: {sent, plural, one {Sent to # household} other {Sent to # households}} ({failed} failed)
email.refused: Resend refused the emails. Without a verified domain you can only send to your own email address (see the README).

recordReply.title: RSVP for {name}
recordReply.description: Record a reply you got by phone, card or message. Deadlines don’t apply to you.
recordReply.nobody: Nobody in this household is invited to an event yet. Invite them from the Guests page.

sms.title: Text your guests
sms.description: Each household gets one SMS with its private RSVP link, sent to the first guest with a phone number.
sms.notSetUp: SMS isn’t set up yet. Add your Twilio credentials as TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID, TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN, and TWILIO_FROM in .env.local (see the README), then restart the app.
sms.willGet: {count} {count, plural, one {household will get a text.} other {households will get a text.}}
sms.skipped: {count} without a phone number will be skipped: {names}. Share their link on WhatsApp instead.
sms.notePlaceholder: e.g. We can’t wait to celebrate with you!
sms.sent: {sent, plural, one {Sent to # household} other {Sent to # households}}
sms.sentFailed: {sent, plural, one {Sent to # household} other {Sent to # households}} ({failed} failed)

invite.title: Send invitations
invite.description: Choose how to reach your guests — by email, text message, or both at once.
invite.neitherSetUp: Neither email nor SMS is set up yet. Add RESEND_API_KEY for email or TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID for SMS in .env.local (see the README), then restart the app.
invite.emailWillGet: {count} {count, plural, one {household will get an email.} other {households will get an email.}}
invite.smsWillGet: {count} {count, plural, one {household will get a text.} other {households will get a text.}}
invite.noContact: {count} without any contact info will be skipped: {names}. Share their link on WhatsApp instead.
invite.notePlaceholder: e.g. We can’t wait to celebrate with you!
invite.send: {count, plural, one {Send to # household} other {Send to # households}}
invite.emailSent: {sent, plural, one {# email sent} other {# emails sent}}
invite.emailResult: {sent, plural, one {# email sent} other {# emails sent}} ({failed} failed)
invite.smsSent: {sent, plural, one {# text sent} other {# texts sent}}
invite.smsResult: {sent, plural, one {# text sent} other {# texts sent}} ({failed} failed)

page.title: Your RSVP page
page.description: Make the page your guests see your own. Leave a box empty to use the standard text.
page.coverHint: Shown at the top of every guest’s RSVP page. JPG, PNG or WebP, up to 10 MB.
page.welcomePlaceholder: We can’t wait to celebrate with you! Please let us know if you can come.
page.thanksHint: Shown after a guest says they’re coming.
page.thanksPlaceholder: Thank you! We’re so happy you’ll be there.
page.sorryHint: Shown after a guest says no for everyone in their household.
page.sorryPlaceholder: We’ll miss you! Thank you for letting us know.
